subject: Social Media
title: Tolerance and Escalation
description: Learn Tolerance and Escalation in one minute.

hook.text: Your first viral post thrilled you. Now a thousand likes feels like nothing. You need more.

buildup.text: Dopamine systems build tolerance. The same stimulus produces less response over time. You chase bigger hits.

discovery.text: This mirrors substance addiction. The first dose works best. After that, you need more to feel normal.

twist.text: Platforms depend on escalation. If you stayed satisfied, you'd stop. Dissatisfaction drives engagement.

climax.text: Some users post increasingly provocative content to recapture the dopamine. The platform rewards it.

quiz.question: Why does social media validation feel less satisfying over time?
options: Algorithms show posts to fewer people
